newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa extends freight paycard use to imports.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa extends freight paycard use to imports.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo AG said it has extended use of its AirPlus freight paycard to import shipments.
The airline was now accepting AirPlus Cargocard payment for imports at all German stations, except Frankfurt at present, a statement said.
Lufthansa Cargo now has about 150 corporate and individual clients using the card, issued by Lufthansa AirPlus Servicekarten GmbH, to pay a monthly bill.
The AirPlus Cargocard speeds up payment, gives an electronic overview of all shipments and permits analysis of transport costs by route, weight or other factors.
